criteria.operational_description: Assess a difference in evidential standards, appraisal, attribution or relevant coverage only against an explicitly declared comparator with supplied passages, inclusion rules and a shared comparison question. State topic, genre, date and available-evidence matching limits; unequal conduct or evidence may justify unequal treatment. Without this comparator, return uncertain for a relevant comparison inquiry or not_applicable when no comparison is attempted, never does_not_meet as a proxy for no bias. Mere corpus absence, different policy instruments or raw voice counts cannot establish omission, a double standard or deliberate selection.
